15: class ContenderObservation:
16:     """Independent path/identity observation. It receives no creation ticket."""
17:     def __init__(self, primitives, monitor, fixed_root):
18:         self.primitives, self.monitor = primitives, monitor
19:         self.directories = journal_setup.GeneratedJournalSetup(primitives, monitor, fixed_root)
20:         self.physical = self.path = None
21:         self.attempted = False
22:         self.attempt_index = None
23:         self.unexpected_handle = None
24: 
25:     def allow_create(self, args):
26:         require(len(args) == 7 and args[3] is None and args[6] is None,
27:                 "fixed_contender_create_shape")
28:         if args[0] in self.directories.directory_paths:
29:             return self.directories.allow_create(args)
30:         require(self.path is not None and args[0] == self.path and not self.attempted
31:                 and args[1:3] == (journal_setup.JOURNAL_ACCESS, 0)
32:                 and args[4:6] == (3, journal_setup.JOURNAL_FLAGS),
33:                 "one_existing_physical_journal_attempt")
34:         self.attempted = True
35:         self.attempt_index = len(self.monitor.calls)
36:         return True
37: 
38:     def run(self):
39:         snapshot = self.directories._scope(self.directories.root)
40:         self.directories._scope(self.directories.registry_path)
41:         identity = snapshot.read_set.identities[-1]
42:         self.physical = PhysicalSnapshot(identity.volume_serial, identity.file_id.hex())
43:         self.path = self.directories.registry_path + "\\" + journal_setup.journal_port.gate_name(self.physical)
44:         value = self.monitor.call("CreateFileW", self.path, journal_setup.JOURNAL_ACCESS,
45:                                   0, None, 3, journal_setup.JOURNAL_FLAGS, None)
46:         error = self.monitor.ffi.get_last_error()
47:         invalid = value in (None, 0, self.monitor.ffi.c_void_p(-1).value)
48:         if not invalid:
49:             # Unexpected success is failed evidence. Retain this exact handle
50:             # until current-process death; no content or fallback write occurs.
51:             self.unexpected_handle = self.primitives._retain(value, "unexpected-contender-journal")
52:         require(self.attempted and invalid and error == 32, "contender_sharing_refusal_required")
53:         for read_set in reversed(self.directories.scopes):
54:             require(self.primitives.release_read_set(read_set) is True,
55:                     "contender_directory_retirement")
56:         require(all(scope.released and not scope.unconfirmed
57:                     and all(handle.closed for handle in scope.members)
58:                     for scope in self.directories.scopes), "contender_guards_retired")
59:         return {"status": "sharing_refused", "physical": self.physical.wire(),
60:                 "journal_path": self.path, "attempt_count": 1, "open_call_index": self.attempt_index,
61:                 "winerror": error, "valid_journal_handle_returned": False,
62:                 "journal_content_reads": 0, "journal_writes": 0,
63:                 "own_directory_guards_retired": True,
64:                 "passive_inherited_guard_retired_by_process_exit_only": True,
65:                 "semantic_choice": "independent-contender", "semantic_revision": "different-revision",
66:                 "semantic_labels_are_authority": False, "model_calls": 0}

69: class OwnedContender:
70:     """One generated observation before the actual durable worker is created."""
71:     def __init__(self, primitives, monitor, primary_setup, bootstrap_path):
72:         self.primitives, self.monitor = primitives, monitor
73:         self.primary, self.bootstrap = primary_setup, bootstrap_path
74:         self.port = self.read_set = self.worker = None
75:         self._bound_port = None
76:         self.entered = self.creating = self.resuming = self.completed = False
77:         self.creation_returned = False
78:         self.start_index = None
79:         self.observation = None
80:         self.failure_type = None
81:         self.stop_attempted = False
82:         self.stop_wait_observed = None
83:         self.milestones = []
84: 
85:     def before_process(self, name, args):
86:         require(self.entered and not self.completed and self.port is not None,
87:                 "active_owned_contender_scope")
88:         token, head = self.primary._confirmed_phase("RESERVED")
89:         require(token.worker is None and self.port.worker is None
90:                 and self.primary.flush_successes == 2 and not self.primary.milestones,
91:                 "primary_journal_remains_reserved_during_contender")
92:         if name == "CreateProcessW":
93:             require(self.creating and not self.resuming and self.worker is None
94:                     and len(self.primitives.workers) == self.start_index + 1,
95:                     "exact_contender_create_slot")
96:             pending = self.primitives.workers[-1]
97:             require(pending.read_set is self.read_set and len(pending.child_read_handles) == 1
98:                     and pending.child_control_handle is None
99:                     and len(self.read_set.members) == 1
100:                     and all(handle is not self.primary.created_handle for handle in self.read_set.members)
101:                     and self.read_set.identities == [self.port.expectations[0][1]],
102:                     "contender_inherits_only_its_passive_fixture_guard")
103:         elif name == "ResumeThread":
104:             require(self.resuming and not self.creating and self.worker is not None
105:                     and args[0] == self.primitives._owned(self.worker.thread),
106:                     "exact_contender_resume_slot")
107:         else:
108:             raise KernelUnconfirmed("Unexpected contender process operation")
109:         self.milestones.append({"api": name, "phase": "RESERVED", "head": head,
110:                                 "call_index": len(self.monitor.calls), "flush_successes": 2})
111: 
112:     def run(self, port, protection, permit, startup, profile):
113:         require(not self.entered and self.monitor.contender is self
114:                 and self._bound_port is port and port._contender is self
115:                 and self.primary.port is port and port.worker is None
116:                 and not port._start_attempted and not port._resume_attempted,
117:                 "one_contender_before_primary_start")
118:         record = port._record(protection, permit)
119:         require(record.phase is Phase.NATIVE_RESERVED and profile is port.profile
120:                 and type(startup) is adapter._OwnedASRStart and startup is port.adapter_startup
121:                 and record is port.lifecycle._records.get(port.key) and record.permit is permit
122:                 and port.authority_events[-1:] == ["owned_start_validated"],
123:                 "contender_requires_existing_primary_reservation")
124:         self.entered, self.port = True, port
125:         token, before_head = self.primary._confirmed_phase("RESERVED")
126:         require(token is port.lifecycle._token(port.key) and token.worker is None
127:                 and token.pending is None and token.generation == port.generation,
128:                 "exact_primary_token_before_contender")
129:         before_raw = token.raw
130:         self.start_index = len(self.primitives.workers)
131:         require(self.start_index == 0, "contender_is_first_owned_process")
132:         try:
133:             # One distinct guard; primary journal/ancestor ownership is not
134:             # handed off or marked worker_reserved by this auxiliary lifetime.
135:             self.read_set = self.primitives.pin_exact_members((port.expectations[0],))
136:             self.creating = True
137:             try:
138:                 self.worker = self.primitives.create_suspended_worker(self.read_set, port.executable,
139:                     ("-I", "-S", "-B", self.bootstrap, "contender"), port.cwd, port.environment)
140:                 self.creation_returned = True
141:             finally:
142:                 self.creating = False
143:             require(self.worker.read_set is self.read_set and self.worker.assigned
144:                     and len(self.worker.child_read_handles) == 1
145:                     and self.worker.child_control_handle is None,
146:                     "exact_contender_owned_lifetime")
147:             self.resuming = True
148:             try:
149:                 self.primitives._resume_after_future_admission(self.worker)
150:             finally:
151:                 self.resuming = False
152:             self.observation = worker_flow._observe_graceful_exit(self.primitives, self.worker, 0)
153:             require(all(not handle.closed for handle in self.read_set.members),
154:                     "contender_parent_guard_held_through_exit")
155:             self.primitives.close_quiescent_worker_handles(self.worker)
156:             require(self.primitives.release_read_set(self.read_set) is True,
157:                     "contender_guard_release_after_exit")
158:             current, after_head = self.primary._confirmed_phase("RESERVED")
159:             require(current is token and current.raw == before_raw and after_head == before_head
160:                     and not self.primary.created_handle.closed and self.primary.flush_successes == 2
161:                     and len(self.milestones) == 2,
162:                     "contender_cannot_change_primary_journal_or_owner")
163:             self.completed = True
164:         except BaseException as error:
165:             self.failure_type = type(error).__name__
166:             # A constructor failure already attempts exact native cleanup in
167:             # the preserved primitive. Recover its retained record, not a PID.
168:             if self.worker is None and len(self.primitives.workers) == self.start_index + 1:
169:                 self.worker = self.primitives.workers[-1]
170:             if self.worker is not None and not self.worker.quiescent:
171:                 if self.creation_returned:
172:                     self.stop_attempted = True
173:                     try:
174:                         self.stop_wait_observed = self.primitives._stop_partial_worker(self.worker, 5000)
175:                     except BaseException as cleanup:
176:                         error.add_note("Contender stop unconfirmed: " + type(cleanup).__name__)
177:                 self.worker.unconfirmed = True
178:             if self.read_set is not None:
179:                 self.read_set.unconfirmed = True
180:             raise
181: 
182:     def receipt(self):
183:         worker = self.worker
184:         return {"completed": self.completed, "failure_type": self.failure_type,
185:                 "milestones": self.milestones, "exit_observation": self.observation,
186:                 "stop_attempted": self.stop_attempted, "stop_wait_observed": self.stop_wait_observed,
187:                 "guard_released": self.read_set is not None and self.read_set.released,
188:                 "worker_handles_closed": worker is not None and all(h is not None and h.closed
189:                     for h in (worker.process, worker.thread, worker.job)),
190:                 "worker_unconfirmed": worker is not None and worker.unconfirmed,
191:                 "observed_pid": None if worker is None or worker.creation_info is None else int(worker.creation_info.pid),
192:                 "observed_creation_time": None if worker is None else worker.creation_time,
193:                 "passive_inherited_guard_count": 0 if worker is None else len(worker.child_read_handles),
194:                 "inherited_control_handle_absent": worker is not None and worker.child_control_handle is None,
195:                 "primary_journal_held_through_contender_exit": self.completed,
196:                 "model_calls": 0}
